s01843.summary: Dr. Sadie leads a resuscitation at twelve minutes while the attending Hargrove watches and Ilse hesitates.
Ben insists on swapping out Sadie's tiring arms; she finally yields.
The monitor shows a rhythm; Sadie insists it is real and Ben finds a pulse.
Sadie accuses Hargrove of mentally calling time of death six minutes ago until he admits it.
Hargrove offers to tell the family; Sadie insists she will and he exits.
Sadie steadies herself at the sink and Ilse tucks the sheet around the patient.

s01719.summary: Sleepless Saoirse and Mateo talk quietly in the hydroponics bay at night.
Mateo notices the drip is irregular; Saoirse finds a vine leaf warm like skin and orders a scan.
Plants turn toward the humans, the mist forms a face, and Orchard says they are not alone.

s00806.summary: Detective Evangeline records case notes on a library fire and a missing librarian.
A tape starts on its own with her own voice telling her she found the right basement.
Following the voice, she clears the shelf, finds a hidden door and opens it with the key.
Inside is a single reel marked PLAY LAST.

s00501.summary: Zeb leads a failing mule across the salt flats with his thirsty son Matt.
Zeb offers Matt the last mouthful of water; Matt shares and Zeb gives the rest to the mule.
A wall of dust approaches; Zeb pulls Matt down and shields him with his coat.
The storm passes, father and son are alive, and the mule waits in the distance.

s02148.summary: Sunderly the dragon confronts Gretel for trespassing in his aching tooth.
Gretel shows her iron pick and offers to fix the rotten tooth, and the dragon allows it.
She wedges the pick in, the tooth cracks and a gold avalanche buries her knees; she laughs.

s02301.summary: Four teens banter in a treehouse as Bo plays ukulele badly.
Soledad announces she is leaving for Tucson at seven in the morning.
They wordlessly cling to her as Bo stares at the dark where the ukulele fell.

s01236.summary: Disguised as janitors, three thieves descend in a freight elevator and rehearse their plan.
The guard's desk is empty and the lamp clicks off, and the vault door stands open.
The guard, eating biscuits inside the vault, greets them casually and urges them to act tonight.
The lights go out; the guard lights a candle, saying the sale starts at nine.

s01600.summary: Victor and Iris trade guarded remarks in their penthouse, both hiding something.
A fake waiter in military shoes brings champagne, claiming Henri has the night off.
Leonard names Delacroix, a man Victor told Iris was dead, and pours three glasses.

s00800.summary: Two burglars pry open a wedding cake that hides a safe and bicker over the code.
A wrong code trips an alarm; they tumble into the cake and blame each other.
The safe opens to reveal only a note from Mom, leaving them covered in frosting.

s01681.summary: Crew members tend tomatoes in a lunar greenhouse; the commander checks in.
Lights flicker, the hum drops, and every plant leans toward the airlock door.

s01238.summary: Vito gathers nephew Dante, Odette and accountant Sundar in a back office before dawn.
Vito orders Dante to read the ledger's third page as accusations and argument break out.
Vito shows a photo of Dante passing an envelope to a stranger who is Vito's man.
Vito murmurs blood and dials a single digit on the phone.

s01175.summary: Felix and mother-in-law Gloria sit stuck in a car wash; he explains it away.
They both apologize at once for the wedding toast as the brushes stop.

s02497.summary: Apprentice Sorrel grinds herbs in a whale-bone shop when the door opens on nobody.
A drowned sailor materializes and asks Sorrel for a remedy for breathing.

s00517.summary: Crew fill a stalled locomotive's water tank while the marshal stands guard.
The telegraph clerk warns of eight or ten riders on the ridge; Delphine demands speed.
Water crashes down, the crew scatters, riders appear and the locomotive lurches away.

s00914.summary: Travelers aboard the marsh ferry trade quips; Pipkin bickers with his lantern.
The ferry enters green stillness; Bracken warns of something old and all ready their weapons.
A great shape ripples and vanishes; Bracken calls it a greeting and Yarrow gifts Pipkin a sprig.

s01539.summary: Five petitioners kneel before the Willow King and complain of the thinning river.
Ivo says the dead stag walks and lowers his hood to reveal antlers and dead eyes.

s00399.summary: Four wedding-bound strangers in a stalled elevator keep tight smiles; Vijay frets over the ring.
Maintenance reveals the groom called about the trapped group; Winifred admits she is the bride's mother.
Vijay opens the ring box and finds it empty.

s01497.summary: Captain Winifred steadies panicking deckhand Amadeo on a sinking trawler with gallows humor.
A swell slams the hull, the boat settles, and they affirm they are still here.

s00774.summary: Bakers in a converted bus depot discuss shortages of rye for Thursday's orders.
Old bus driver Winston visits, reminisces about the depot and gets a warm roll.

s01934.summary: Sergeant Costa eats sardines in a ruined bell tower, hearing a scrape on the stairs.
A wounded soldier climbs up begging not to be shot; Costa lowers his rifle and shares food.
Tadeusz admits his unit is below looking for Costa and apologizes; they threatened his brother.

s01387.summary: Tallis poles up to Ilsebeth's silent raft in the floating bell market.
Ilsebeth tells the crowd the river is dropping and they must choose to wait or leave tonight.
She confirms tow help with Tallis and pushes off; the ropes are cast and the bells ring.

s00054.summary: Sheriff Bell questions Sparrow about being near the Henderson place; Clementine vouches for him.
Sparrow offers a carved bird, denies the killing and points to the sweating deputy Willet.
Sparrow slides the bird toward shaking Willet as Bell turns on him and the wind stops.

s00921.summary: Detective Imogen climbs a grain elevator catwalk while others lurk above and below.
Abebe holds a lever, Rafferty greets her, Maxi claims the ledger, and a conveyor groans awake.

s00164.summary: Corporate auditor Marigold presses mattress manager Cassius about sixty percent lower sales.
Marigold tests the Cloud Nine, finding it the best mattress she has tried, and learns why staff nap.
She removes her shoes and lies down; Cassius covers her and turns off the lights.

s00920.summary: In a drowned chapel tower, travelers share broth while a hooded stranger sits apart.
Pip counts four bells where the chart shows three, and the stranger confirms it.
The stranger unhoods as Corvane, the fourth bell; a toll rises and he says they will ring with him.

s01646.summary: Maude and Ferdie bicker over a tuna and escalate bids at the fish auction.
Both reveal they bid for their sisters' wedding, laugh, split the tuna and shake hands.

s02347.summary: Helena shows Jo yellowing plants crumbling to powder, and a radiation reading on the readout.
They reveal the commander keeps secrets from Jo, and the shielding was rated for the old sun.
The commander calls all hands and Cadet Lisandra says there is an eleven-hour window to decide on evacuating half.
A flare lights the stars as the shield fails, sirens sound and Wu summons them.
